content_sections.heading: About SBC Exports
content_sections.text: M/s. SBC Exports Ltd. describes itself in the notice as an outsourcing agency for the supply of manpower services, on contract basis, to HBCH and MPMMCC, Varanasi. This recruitment is for deployment at those two linked centres, Homi Bhabha Cancer Hospital and Mahamana Pandit Madan Mohan Malviya Cancer Centre.

content_sections.heading: SBC Exports Scientific Assistant Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: Age limit: 30 years, as on the last date of application. Essential education and experience: candidates must meet either of these two options. Preference: candidates with experience in Biomedical Waste Treatment will be given preference. See the official notification (PDF) for the full eligibility conditions of this post.

rows.qualification: B.Sc. (in any stream) with 50% marks and Degree/Diploma in Medical Laboratory Technology (DMLT)
rows.experience: One year in an institutional based laboratory
Minimum 2 years in an institutional based laboratory

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Initial screening, based on the information given in the online application form. Interview for the candidates called after screening. The Agency reserves the right not to call any candidates for interview without assigning any reason. If a candidate is found ineligible at any stage, or has given incorrect, false or incomplete information or suppressed a material fact, the candidature will be cancelled. If a shortcoming is detected even after appointment, the candidate's services are liable to be terminated forthwith.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: The appointment is on contract basis (locum) and is valid till 13 March 2027 only. The selected candidate will be deployed at the Varanasi centres named above through the outsourcing agency. Accommodation will not be provided to outstation candidates.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for SBC Exports Scientific Assistant Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Open the online application form . Candidature is accepted through this online route only. Fill in every detail, since incomplete applications will be summarily rejected. Give a valid email ID that you check regularly, including its spam or bulk folder. All correspondence is by email only, and the candidate is responsible for receiving, downloading and printing related documents. Internal candidates need to submit an NOC from their current HOD/OIC/Principal Investigator. Submit the form before the deadline. The Agency takes no responsibility for non-receipt of online applications. Documents to carry to the interview: original documents supporting the details in the online form, covering date of birth, qualifications, experience, etc. Candidates without them will not be allowed to appear for the interview.

faq.question: Q1. Can a B.Sc. graduate from any stream apply?
faq.answer: Yes, with 50% marks, provided the candidate also holds a Degree/Diploma in Medical Laboratory Technology (DMLT) and has one year of experience in an institutional based laboratory.

faq.question: Q2. How much experience does a B.Sc. (Medical Laboratory Technology) holder need?
faq.answer: A minimum of 2 years in an institutional based laboratory, along with 50% marks in the degree.

faq.question: Q3. Is experience in biomedical waste compulsory?
faq.answer: No. It is listed as a preference: candidates with experience in Biomedical Waste Treatment will be preferred, but the essential requirement is laboratory experience.

faq.question: Q4. How long will this job last?
faq.answer: The appointment is valid till 13 March 2027 only, so it is a short contract engagement.

faq.question: Q5. How will I know my interview date?
faq.answer: The date of interview will be sent by email, and only to eligible candidates. The Agency is not responsible for emails lost because of a wrong email ID or delivered to a spam folder.

faq.question: Q6. Is accommodation provided for candidates from outside Varanasi?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that accommodation will not be provided to outstation candidates.

faq.question: Q7. Do internal candidates need any extra document?
faq.answer: Yes. They need to submit an NOC from their current HOD, OIC or Principal Investigator.
